text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Wooo! There's nothing like an early
morning run! Getting in some stretches
while soaking up the
morning sun—I'm in
top form again today! ☆

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Ngh, dammit! I need to kick off the ground harder!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Wait a second... Hey! Hold it! STOP!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That's it! You're doing great! It's easier
to run
now, right? Keep that up. ☆

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! It's working! I'm getting further
than before!
Um, thank you!

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
Also... I'm sorry I got so nervous when
you called out to me. I thought maybe
you were going to
give me some feng
shui advice...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
There's really nothing shady about feng
shui,
though. Still, that stuff can wait
until next time!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I actually learned how to run like that
from my
trainer!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
My trainer gave me clear advice and
helped me actually put it into practice.
That's why I was able
to give you those
tips.

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Are you sure it's all right for you
to share
such an important technique
with me?!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm sure. I want to pass on what I
learn.
That'll make everyone happy,
don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Besides, by going over what I learned
with you, I
can review what my trainer
taught me!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Hey, I'm suddenly in the mood for
a good
run! Why don't we go together?
